question: does a task exist where a depth-2 backprop ORACLE underfits held-out at ALL widths (P1) AND a depth-3 oracle clears it >0.85, SGD-learnable, on a novel-combination split (P2)?
method: self-contained numpy MLP backprop oracle (ReLU, softmax-CE / MSE, Adam), depth in {1,2,3,4,5} x width sweep {16..512} x 2 seeds, over 5 candidate task families + controls
verdict: ZERO — no task exhibits the property; the failure is STRUCTURAL (fundamental for a plain-MLP oracle class), not a search miss

per_family_heldout.why: depth-2 does NOT underfit; width substitutes for depth
all depths memorize (train->1.0, held-out below chance)
k=3 depth-2 CAN do it; k=5 nobody learns

obstruction.representation_route: the depth-2->depth-3 increment is ~one extra composition (squaring linear-piece count), but a width-W depth-2 net already yields O(W) pieces. Provable depth-2 lower bounds need width EXPONENTIAL in the depth-GAP, and the gap is 1 -> anything depth-3 represents (~2^3 oscillations) a width-16 depth-2 also represents (P1 fails). Forcing depth-2 to underfit needs depth >> 3, not SGD-learnable (tent^5 sat at chance for every depth incl 3-5) (P2 fails). The separable window and the learnable window do not overlap.
obstruction.generalization_route: systematic generalization needs an inductive bias to REUSE intermediate factors (weight-tying / bottleneck / recurrence / attention). Plain fully-connected depth is NOT that bias — it is capacity (more memorization; depth-3 generalized WORSE on nested_lookup). Add structure for depth-3 to generalize -> a shallow net exploits it too (P1 fails); remove it -> held-out underdetermined, no depth generalizes (P2 fails).
obstruction.root_cause: for a plain MLP, depth's only lever is representational capacity; the depth-2->depth-3 increment is exponentially small vs width (representation) and not an inductive bias at all (generalization) — so no bounded-width depth-2 net can be made to underfit EXACTLY what a bounded-width depth-3 net fits, at toy scale, under SGD.

consequence_for_gap4: the premise 're-pose the transport-free DFA e-prop depth-3 sweep on a depth-3-obligatory TASK with a plain-MLP oracle ceiling' is UNACHIEVABLE — no such task exists for that oracle class. This is fundamental, and CORROBORATES 2026-08-02-gap4-DFA-eprop-is-depth-robust-scales-to-N4. Do NOT wire a new --task into the depth3 runner; the held-out-accuracy framing cannot separate depth-2 from depth-3.

corrected_measurement.reframe: re-pose the depth-3 credit question as LAYER-3 CREDIT FIDELITY, not task accuracy depth-2 can't reach
corrected_measurement.task: train a 3-hidden-layer net to FIT a genuinely depth-3-composed target where all-train fit provably engages layer 3 — tent^3 regression (v=tent(tent(tent(x))), MSE) or quasigroup DEPTH-3 chain (train-fit only). Small input, seconds. Additive --task tent3_fit / qgroup3_fit, default-off, data-only, NO sim/ edit.
corrected_measurement.go_gate: transport-free DFA e-prop reaches (a) layer-3 weight-update cosine-alignment to the backprop-oracle layer-3 gradient >= 0.6 AND rising with training, AND (b) final train-loss within 10% of the backprop-oracle depth-3 loss. Compare vs the depth-2 oracle on the same target: depth-2 train-loss must be strictly worse (confirms depth-3-engaging on FIT).
anti_cheats: backprop-oracle ceiling exists + hits loss~0 at depth-3
depth-separating — the same rule at depth-2 cannot fit the depth-3 target (loss floor)
lever-moved — apical-lesion / B=0 collapses layer-3 alignment to ~0
transport-free assertion — credit path reads only fixed-random/KP feedback + local activity, never a forward W^T
